set.review_summary: Many drivers like it as a well-built load cell upgrade after G29 pedals (it connects to a PC by USB, not to the G29), with easy setup and adjustable springs or elastomers. Brake consistency is the doubt, with a few finding it inconsistent or needing a lot of force. One unit's haptics froze until power cycled, and one driver hated it.
